description: Start a search for a pattern in files under a path and return a session id

filePattern.description: Optional glob pattern limiting which files are searched

maxResults.description: Optional maximum number of results to return

path.description: The directory path to search under

searchType.description: Optional search type: 'files' searches file names, 'literal' matches the pattern literally, otherwise the pattern is treated as a regular expression over file contents

name: start_search
